title: Welcome to My Blog
author: Admin
content:
This is your new blog app, built with Python and Flask.

You can create new posts, edit existing ones, and delete posts you no longer need. All posts are saved in a JSON file, so no database is required.

Click the "New Post" button at the top to get started!

title: Why I Love Python
author: Admin
content:
Python is a versatile and beginner-friendly programming language. It powers everything from simple scripts to massive web applications.

Here are a few reasons why I love Python:

1. Clean, readable syntax
2. Huge ecosystem of libraries
3. Great community support
4. Works everywhere

What do you love about Python?
